_note: Skyreach Peaks (Docs/Expansion.md §8, builder skyreach, prefixes sr / dg6). The Frozen Sanctum (hidden dungeon, 30-32): map, creatures cr_dg6_*, gear, loot, The Long Watch.

props.text: A stone altar with a hymn carved round its edge. The letters are full of frost, so the words read white: SLEEP, AND BE STILL, AND DREAM OF SNOW.
A young squire frozen in the ice, one hand still on a horn at his belt. Somebody has scratched a heron on the ice over his heart, from the outside.
The hierophant's altar. A single candle still burns on it, blue and without heat, as it has burned for five hundred years.

regions.name: Hall of the Watch
regions.text: The Frozen Sanctum. Knights stand along the hall in their armour, caught in the ice mid-step, as if they had only stopped to listen.

regions.name: Hymn Hall
regions.text: The Hymn Hall. A thin, cold singing drifts between the pillars. It has been singing for five hundred years and it is slightly flat.

regions.name: The Knights' Rest
regions.text: The Knights' Rest. Bedrolls, a cold hearth, a stack of shields with herons on them. They made camp here, and the cold came in after them.

regions.name: Vael's Chantry
regions.successText: Behind the altar the frost has a draught in it. A reliquary niche, sealed with ice and hidden for centuries.
regions.failText: The chantry is cold, and very quiet, and you would rather not stay.

regions.name: Heart of Winter
regions.text: The Heart of Winter. Every breath freezes on your lips, and something vast and blue is waiting in the ice.

creatures.name: Sanctum Ice Sentinel
creatures.description: Old ice, carved into a temple guard and then forgotten about for five hundred years.

creatures.name: Rimebound Colossus
creatures.description: A sentinel the Rimeheart fed until it would not stop growing.

creatures.name: Rime-Priest Wight
creatures.description: Once a priest of the sanctum, who prayed for the cold to keep something asleep. The cold kept him instead.

creatures.name: Wight Chanter
creatures.description: Still chanting the old hymn. It is the only thing it remembers, and it is slightly off-key.

creatures.name: Hierophant Vael
creatures.description: The last high priest of the sanctum, who bound the Rimeheart here and then could not bear to leave it.
creatures.bark: The hymn must not stop. If the hymn stops, she wakes.

creatures.name: Hoarfang
creatures.description: A frost drake who crawled into the sanctum to die, a century ago, and was too cold to manage it.

creatures.name: Rime Shard
creatures.description: A splinter of the Rimeheart, walking.

creatures.name: The Rimeheart
creatures.description: An elemental lord of glacier ice with a blazing frozen heart. It has been drinking the warmth out of the sanctum for five hundred years, and it is still thirsty.
creatures.bark: *The cavern groans. Something vast and blue unfolds from the ice, and the air is suddenly too cold to breathe.*

abilities.name: Hoarfrost Breath

abilities.name: Shards, Awake

abilities.name: Deep Winter

abilities.name: Heart of Winter

auras.name: Undying Cold
auras.description: Grave-cold: resistant to Frost and Shadow.

items.name: Rimeheart Shard
items.description: A splinter of the Rimeheart, hilted in silver. It is never warm, and never blunt.

items.name: Hymnal of the Rime-Priests
items.description: The old hymn, written in frost on vellum. It is slightly off-key.

items.name: Glacier-Heart Girdle
items.description: A mail belt with a clasp of glacier ice that never melts.

items.name: Frostbound Handwraps
items.description: Silk wraps rimed in frost. Spells cast through them crackle.

items.name: Sanctum Strider Boots
items.description: Leather boots that grip ice like a cat grips a curtain.

items.name: The Long Watch
items.description: Lord-Commander Aubric's greatsword, thawed at last. A heron is etched on the blade, wings open.

items.name: Crown of Seven Spires
items.description: Seven spires of white ice that never melt. It is very cold to wear, and worth it.

items.name: Rimehide Jerkin
items.description: Leather dyed the blue of deep ice, stitched with frost that crackles when you move.

items.name: Aubric's Oath
items.description: His arming sword, which he gave to the youngest knight to carry home. She never could.

items.name: Lantern of the Long Watch
items.description: Pell lit it from the sanctum's last candle. It burns blue, and warm.

items.name: Thawstring
items.description: A Heronguard bow, restrung with a cord that was frozen for twelve years.

items.name: Heron-Ward Cloak
items.description: River-blue wool lined with fleece, clasped with a silver heron.

items.name: Vael's Chanting Staff
items.description: The hierophant's staff. The hymn is carved along it, so it never has to stop.

items.name: Hoarfang Scale Pauldrons
items.description: Pale blue drake-scale, heavy as a snowdrift.

npcs.name: Lord-Commander Aubric
npcs.title: Heronguard, Long Watch
npcs.bark: *Frost blooms on the air where he stands.*

nodes.speaker: dg6_aubric
nodes.text: *Among the thawing statues one shape stands up out of the melting ice: a tall knight in river-blue, clear as frost on a window. He looks at his hands, then at you.* It's warm. Gods. It's been so long since anything was warm.

choices.text: My lord Aubric. Ysolde is here.
The Rimeheart is gone. Your knights are free.

nodes.speaker: dg6_aubric
nodes.text: *His eyes find Ysolde, and he straightens, the way a knight straightens for his standard-bearer.* Ysolde. You grew up. *She cannot speak. He smiles.* You blew the horn. Good girl. I told the others you would. They owed me a silver each.

nodes.speaker: ysolde
nodes.text: My lord, I... twenty-nine of you, and I... *Her voice breaks. She makes it go on anyway.* I have wondered every day whether you forgave me.

nodes.speaker: dg6_aubric
nodes.text: Forgave you? Twenty-nine of us chose to stay and hold the door so the wounded could get in. That was ours to choose. The horn was yours, and it was right. *He lays a hand on her shoulder; frost blooms on her pauldron and melts.* Keep the fords, Ysolde. We'll keep watch.

nodes.speaker: dg6_aubric
nodes.text: Aubric. Lord-Commander of the Heronguard, once. We came in here with the wounded, out of the drake-fire. The cold took us in our sleep. It wasn't unkind, exactly. It was only... hungry.

nodes.speaker: dg6_aubric
nodes.text: *Around him, one by one, faint shapes stand up out of the ice: knights, a few robed priests, a heron the size of a pony. They bow to you.* Tell old Lumi she can take the flags down. Or leave them up. They're very pretty flags. *He fades like breath on glass.*

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: *At the chantry altar a tall wight in rimed vestments turns. Frost pours from his sleeves. Behind him, two chanters keep up a thin, cold hymn without drawing breath.*

nodes.speaker: dg6_vael
nodes.text: The hymn must not stop. Five hundred years we have sung the Heart to sleep. If the hymn stops, it wakes, and it is hungry. The knights came in out of the fire, and it drank them. It will drink you.

choices.text: Your watch is over, Hierophant. You can rest now.
(Lay a hand on his shoulder and pray with him for the knights.)
By the Light: your vigil is kept. Lay down your staff.
Then we will end the Heart, and the hymn with it.

nodes.speaker: dg6_vael
nodes.text: *The hierophant looks at his own hands for a long time, as if he had forgotten he had them.* Rest. *The chanters fall silent. Vael sets his staff on the altar, bows to you, and is only frost on the air.* Then end it, little warm ones. End it well.

nodes.speaker: dg6_vael
nodes.text: Rest? There is no rest. There is only the hymn. *The chanters' voices rise, and the cold rises with them.*

nodes.speaker: dg6_vael
nodes.text: Then you are the Heart's, as they were. *He lifts his staff.* Sing, brothers. SING.

quests.name: The Long Watch
quests.summary: Twenty-nine Heronguard knights went into the old temple behind Glasswater Falls with their wounded, twelve years ago, and never came out. Bring them home.

stages.description: Find the Frozen Sanctum behind the frozen falls (Odran may know where the door is) and go inside.
Find what keeps the knights in the cold, and end it.
Speak with the spirit that rises from the thawing ice.
Tell Old Lumi that the twenty-nine are free.
